messages:
devex-liu: Heads up — planned py/ts SDK publish at 17:00 PT today. We're rotating the publish credentials (KMS key swap) during the change window. Need eyes on pin strategy + rollback plan. Any blockers?

ben: Do we have a dist-tag strategy? i.e., shadow -> canary -> latest, or publishing straight to canary and then promoting?

samira: Can we avoid a full republish if the signer changes? last time we had to yank wheels.

ops-ella: +1 on that. If KMS swap changes signatures, package registry may reject artifacts. We should coordinate a short grace window where both old and new keys are valid. Who owns the republish script?

publish-bot: [automated] planned-release: SDK publish job queued (job-id: sdk-pub-2026-03-21-17). No active failures.

devex-liu: Plan: 1) push to shadow (dist-tag=shadow) with new creds; 2) smoke tests (smoke matrix in CI) for 10m; 3) promote to canary if green; 4) after 1h of canary traffic and no regressions, promote to latest. If the signing mismatch happens, fallback is to keep old dist-tag and revert promotion.

ben: ok. For backwards compatibility we should pin the TS client to the py-ts compatibility shim (see repo: infra/sdk-shims). Add a deprecation blurb too so downstreams know to switch off legacy sync client.

samira: For the republish script — i can run it but we need the exact command in ops runbook. Is it just `scripts/republish --registry npm,pypi --signing-key=ENV`?

devex-liu: yes, that's the command. Full snippet for runbook: ```bash
export NEW_SIGNING_KEY=projects/myproj/locations/global/keyRings/sdk/cryptoKeys/publish-v2
./scripts/republish --targets npm,pypi --sign-key=$NEW_SIGNING_KEY --dist-tag shadow
```

ops-ella: I'll coordinate the KMS policy change with security so both keys are active for a 30m overlap. After overlap window we lock old key. I'll post exact times when scheduled.

publish-bot: [automated] smoke-run: triggered (job-id: smoke-321). Tests: packaging, install matrix (py3.9-3.11, node16-20), basic client init.

ben: Rollback criteria: - packaging test fails for any runtime, or - >2 client errors in canary logs in first 30m, or - signature mismatch causing manifests to be rejected. If any of these, we unpromote canary and revert dist-tag pointing back to previous tarball.

samira: Add to release notes: "Credential rotation: signing key rotated for published artifacts. If you pin by dist-tag, no action. If you vendor signed wheels/tarballs, re-verify signatures after 17:30 PT." Also include deprecation note for legacy sync: "sync client will be removed in next major — migrate to async client by X.Y.Z"

devex-liu: Good. Action items: @ops-ella schedule KMS overlap window and share timeline in this thread; @samira prepare republish script & add runbook snippet to release-runbook.md; @ben prepare dist-tag promotion script and rollback hook; I'll draft short release notes and add deprecation blurb. We'll do a quick sync at +5m before publish.

ops-ella: Scheduled KMS overlap: 17:00-17:30 PT. I'll add calendar invite to #release-windows and tag security.

publish-bot: [automated] status: queued -> running (sdk-pub-2026-03-21-17). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/sdk-pub-2026-03-21-17

ben: If anything goes sideways, call rollback: `./scripts/rollback-dist --tag canary --to-ref <sha>` — have that ready.

samira: republish ready, runbook updated: https://docs.internal/release-runbook#sdk-credential-rotation (added command & recovery steps).

devex-liu: thanks all. Will post final go/no-go at t-5. If we hit signature issues, priority is to unpromote and keep stable latest untouched. :thumbsup:

publish-bot: [automated] done: publish job completed. result: shadow artifacts published. smoke-run passed. Next: promote-canary job queued.
